notes: Java rebuilt from beginner to professional for Java 25: 17 new lessons and a "Working like a pro" unit (Maven and Gradle, linters, JUnit, CI, dependency injection, web servers, logging, packaging)
New Java lessons on files, dates and time zones, annotations and reflection, modules, the memory model, CompletableFuture, secure deserialization, calling C with the FFM API and profiling with JFR
Every Java exercise has tests proven to reject common wrong answers, and every lesson has a "Common mistakes" note
